Foring this Victory Day
2019-12-10T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/news/foring-victory-day-1837708

16 December is right around the corner, and to celebrate this glorious day, fashion house Foring is ready with a number of new designs. The showrooms are all set with saris, panjabis, shalwar kameezs, t-shirts, and shirts in red and green. Embroidery, applique, block spray and hand paint, tie-dye etc. adorn the clothes, commemorating this special day. For more information, visit https://facebook.com/foringlimited
